description: Backend: Refactor payment system from invoice/redirect to direct payment API (QRIS, Virtual Account, E-Wallet). Create new migration for extended payments table, new PaymentService with Xendit direct payment APIs, new PaymentsController, update webhook handler, and wire up routes.
steps: Step 1 - Create new migration to alter payments table: Create a new migration file in ecommerce-api/database/migrations/ that drops and recreates the payments table with these columns: id (auto-increment), order_id (FK to orders), payment_provider (string, default 'xendit'), payment_method (string: QRIS, VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT, EWALLET), payment_channel (string nullable, e.g. BCA, BNI, BRI, MANDIRI, OVO, DANA, GOPAY), external_payment_id (string nullable unique - Xendit's payment request id), external_reference_id (string unique - our reference), amount (decimal 12,2), status (string: PENDING, PAID, FAILED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED), qr_string (text nullable), qr_url (string nullable), va_number (string nullable), ewallet_url (string nullable - deeplink/redirect for e-wallet), expiry_date (timestamp nullable), paid_at (timestamp nullable), raw_response (json nullable), webhook_payload (json nullable), created_at, updated_at. Also update the orders migration or add a new one to: add PROCESSING to the status enum, ensure paid_at column exists.

Step 2 - Update the Payment model (ecommerce-api/app/models/payment.ts): Add all new columns as @column declarations. Add JSON prepare/consume for webhook_payload. Add relationship back to Order. Add status type as union.

Step 3 - Update the Order model (ecommerce-api/app/models/order.ts): Add 'PROCESSING' and 'CANCELLED' to the status union type. Change hasOne Payment to hasMany (an order could have retry payments). Remove xenditInvoiceId and xenditInvoiceUrl columns (they belong to the old invoice flow).

Step 4 - Create PaymentService (ecommerce-api/app/services/PaymentService.ts): This replaces XenditService for payment creation. It should: (a) Import Xendit from xendit-node and use the PaymentRequest API (xendit.PaymentRequest). (b) Have method createPayment({orderId, paymentMethod, paymentChannel?}) that: finds the order, validates it is PENDING, generates a reference_id, calls Xendit PaymentRequest.createPaymentRequest with the correct payload per method (QRIS: payment_method type=QR_CODE, reusability=ONE_TIME_USE; VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT: type=VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT with channel_code; EWALLET: type=EWALLET with channel_code). (c) Saves the Payment record with data from Xendit response (qr_string from actions[].qr_code for QRIS, va_number from channel_properties.virtual_account_number for VA, deeplink URL for ewallet). (d) Returns the payment details to the controller. (e) Have method getPaymentStatus(paymentId) that fetches a payment by ID and returns its current status along with payment details. (f) Have method handleWebhook(payload, callbackToken) that: validates the callback token, finds payment by external_payment_id or external_reference_id, updates payment status (maps Xendit statuses SUCCEEDED->PAID, FAILED->FAILED, etc.), saves webhook_payload, if PAID: updates order status to PROCESSING, reduces stock (reuse existing stock reduction logic from XenditService), sets paid_at. Must be idempotent. (g) Handle edge cases: payment already paid (skip), amount mismatch, order not found, expired payment.

Step 5 - Create PaymentValidator (ecommerce-api/app/validators/PaymentValidator.ts): Using VineJS, create validators: (a) createPaymentValidator: orderId (number, required), paymentMethod (enum: QRIS, VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT, EWALLET), paymentChannel (string, optional but required when paymentMethod is VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT or EWALLET). (b) webhookPayloadValidator: validate the Xendit webhook payload structure for payment requests (event, data.id, data.reference_id, data.status, data.amount, etc.).

Step 6 - Create PaymentsController (ecommerce-api/app/controllers/payments_controller.ts): (a) POST /payments/create - authenticated. Validate with createPaymentValidator, call PaymentService.createPayment, return payment details (qr_string, va_number, ewallet_url, expiry_date, etc.). (b) GET /payments/:id/status - authenticated. Call PaymentService.getPaymentStatus, return status and payment info. (c) POST /webhooks/xendit - public. Validate callback token from x-callback-token header, validate body with webhookPayloadValidator, call PaymentService.handleWebhook, return 200.

Step 7 - Update routes (ecommerce-api/start/routes.ts): (a) Remove old invoice routes (POST /invoices, GET /invoices/:id, POST /invoices/:id/expire). (b) Update the webhook route to point to new PaymentsController.webhook. (c) Add authenticated routes: POST /payments/create -> PaymentsController.store, GET /payments/:id/status -> PaymentsController.show. (d) Keep GET /orders/:orderId/payment-status (update OrdersController to also return latest payment info).

Step 8 - Remove or deprecate old XenditService invoice methods: Keep verifyWebhookToken and the stock reduction logic but remove createInvoice, getInvoice, expireInvoice, and the old handleWebhookStatus. Optionally delete InvoicesController if no longer needed. Remove InvoiceValidator if fully replaced.
Step 9 - Update OrdersController.paymentStatus to also return latest payment details (method, channel, qr_string, va_number, status) by preloading the payment relationship.
Step 10 - Add a migration to remove xendit_invoice_id and xendit_invoice_url columns from orders table (since the new flow does not use invoices). Create a new migration that drops these columns.
acceptance_criteria: TypeScript compilation passes: `npm run build` in ecommerce-api succeeds without errors
New payments migration creates the extended table with all required columns
PaymentService correctly structures Xendit PaymentRequest API calls for QRIS, VA, and E-Wallet
Webhook handler is idempotent - processing same webhook twice does not duplicate effects
Stock reduction is wrapped in a transaction with proper rollback on failure
Old invoice-based routes and controller methods are removed
New routes POST /payments/create and GET /payments/:id/status are registered under auth middleware
Webhook route POST /webhooks/xendit remains public (no auth middleware)
verification: Run `cd /projects/sandbox/E-Commerce-With-Adonis-js/ecommerce-api && npm run build` - must succeed
Run `cd /projects/sandbox/E-Commerce-With-Adonis-js/ecommerce-api && npx tsc --noEmit` - must pass type checking
findings: All pre-existing TS errors remain unchanged (17 errors in auth_controller, biteship_controller, carts_controller, product_images_controller, uploads_controller, wishlists_controller, auth_middleware, config/mail - none in new code). Build with --ignore-ts-errors succeeds. The xendit-node v7 PaymentRequest API uses createPaymentRequest({data}) method. Response contains actions[] array for QR codes and e-wallet URLs, and paymentMethod.virtualAccount.channelProperties for VA numbers.
